notes.title: Dev Progress + Release Date News
notes.notes:
[h3]Development Progress[/h3][p]It’s been radio silence for a few months regarding any news about the game, but I’m here to assure you that development is still going strong! Aside from a few occasional pauses due to personal health reasons, I’ve been working hard to get this game to completion. Here’s what I’ve been working on over the past few months:[/p][list][*][p][b]Controller mapping[/b]: This was relatively simple considering the game has minimal controls, though I still need to make the UI controller-friendly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chapter 2 level design[/b]: Things really start to escalate here; The atmosphere becomes much more unsettling and mysterious.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chapter 2 storyline[/b]: More eventful story beats unfold, uncovering the grim reality of what happened to the family in the house Emma is trapped in.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chapter 3 level design[/b]: Without spoiling too much, let’s just say this chapter will tie up many loose threads and take place in an entirely different environment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor quality-of-life changes[/b]: Improved FOV, subtle highlights on objects Emma reacts to, and minor lighting tweaks.[/p][/*][/list][p]On top of this, I’ve been tinkering with FL Studio and learning to make simple music tracks! It’s mostly experimental, but there’s a good chance I’ll compose something ambient for the game.[/p][h3]Release Date[/h3][p]To be honest, it’s been difficult to pin down an estimated release date. Initially, I was confident the game would be done by the end of August, but I couldn’t have been more wrong. Every internal deadline I’ve set for myself has ended up taking longer than expected, so I don’t want to give a date only to postpone it again.[/p][p]That being said, I’m working on a trailer that I plan to upload once the game’s development is 99% complete. This will serve as the [b]release announcement trailer[/b], and by that point, I’ll be confident there won’t be any further delays.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience! If you’d like to keep up with my day-to-day updates, I frequently post on X and Instagram:

X - [url="https://x.com/dev_mustang"]https://x.com/dev_mustang[/url]
Instagram - [url="https://www.instagram.com/mustang_dev/"]https://www.instagram.com/mustang_dev[/url][/p]

notes.title: INDIE GAME UTSAV SALE + Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
I am happy to announce that Blinding Oversight is now part of the Indie Game Utsav event! This event showcases amazing games made by Indian developers and you should definitely check them out. Big thanks to Nodwin Gaming and Nodding Heads Games for hosting the event on Steam!

Check out the sale page here: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ComicConxIndieGameUtsav[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ComicConxIndieGameUtsav][/url]

Before I begin listing the changes I have made, I want to give a huge thanks to everyone who has played the demo and wishlisted the game so far! Progress has been steady, and soon I will be updating the art capsule and logo as well. Now let's list the changes!
[list]
[*] Added a "Photo-sensitivity Warning" screen at the start of the game. My apologies for not adding this warning earlier.
[*] Added a small tip that shows what the controls are. This should have also been added earlier, I cannot expect everyone to assume "E" is the interact button. Whoops!
[*] Lighting has been improved in certain areas of the map.
[*] Audio has been fixed so they're not loud but also directional.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I've done a few minor changes to the User Interface of the demo:
[list]
[*] The resolution selection is now a dropdown list instead of a horizontal selector.
[*] Added a brightness bar to change the gamma of the game. The difference will be pretty minor. A very bright scene would not match with the intended atmosphere of the game.
[/list]

If you wish to talk to the developer of the game, feel free to join the discord: https://discord.gg/huCjEr7
